name: Northline Plumbing
helpText: we answer texts about bookings, quotes and emergencies

whatsapp.//: Omit `sender` and set useSandbox while waiting on Meta approval. The sandbox is shared, so only one tenant can claim it.

serviceArea: Calgary and Airdrie. We do not travel past Okotoks.

escalation.transferWhen: caller is angry, mentions a flood or gas smell, is an existing customer with a complaint, or explicitly asks for a human

outbound.//: Every trigger is off unless enabled. Quiet hours (9am-8pm in this tenant's timezone) apply to all of them and are not per-trigger.

reminders.//template: Content SID of a Meta-approved template. Required only if the reminder may land outside WhatsApp's 24-hour window.

faq.a: Yes, licensed and insured in Alberta.

neverSay: Do not quote a dollar price. Say a technician confirms pricing on site.
Do not promise same-day service. Offer the earliest real opening instead.
